answer_1.quote: Text summarization aims to compress a long input text and generate a condensed summary.
answer_1.outputs: overall summary, user summary, agent summary

answer_2.quote: We employ five widely used automatic metrics to evaluate the above methods. The automatic metrics include: ROUGE-based methods ... ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L ... BLEU ... BERTScore ... MoverScore.

answer_4.quote: Next, we choose the outputs of some summarization methods and let humans evaluate them ... We recruit three well-educated volunteers to evaluate the three different types of summaries generated from four methods.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate summaries on informativeness, non-redundancy, and fluency using a three-point scale (0 worst, 1 medium, 2 best).
